summary: This XML defines a button control for what appears to be an Office application (like Word or Excel). It sets up a large button labeled 'Button' with a happy face icon that will trigger a function called OnButtonClicked when someone clicks it.

explanations.2: The id attribute gives this button a unique name so other parts of the code can reference it if needed.
explanations.4: imageMso means 'image from Microsoft Office' — it's telling the system to use a built-in happy face icon rather than loading a custom image file.
explanations.6: onAction specifies which function to run when the user clicks the button; in this case it will call a function named OnButtonClicked.
